describe_dataset.description: Read how MANTO is put together: every record type it publishes, the fields each one carries and the kinds of tie a record can hold, with the IDs Search any record type takes. Run it once to learn which field names the other actions will hand back before building on them. No account or API key required.

description: Look up the people, places and stories of Greek myth in MANTO, the linked open dataset of Greek mythology built by Greta Hawes and R. Scott Smith: some 4,800 gods, heroes, monsters and animals, the collectives they belong to, the places, landmarks and objects of the storyworld and the events in it, each with the ties the ancient sources record between them and a stable address to cite. Search by name, read an entity and everything connected to it, page through the whole dataset, or read how it is put together. No account or API key required.
